provider.name: Open Tree of Life
provider.organization_type: global taxonomic-reference, phylogenetic-study, source-tree curation, taxonomic-name-resolution, synthetic-tree, API, download, and open-source infrastructure
provider.description: Open Tree of Life integrates a reference taxonomy with curated published phylogenetic trees to produce a comprehensive synthetic tree of life. It provides the Open Tree Taxonomy and OTT identifiers, taxonomic name resolution, curated study and source-tree metadata, OTU-to-taxon mappings, synthetic-tree services, conflict analysis, versioned releases, REST APIs, downloads, documentation, and open-source software.
